dashboard.label: TA-psi Overview
dashboard.description: Collects PSI (pressure stall information) for CPU, memory and IO from /proc/pressure: some/full averages over 10s/60s/300s, including per-cgroup v2 pressure files when present.

panel.html: Commercial Use Commercial or production use of TA-psi requires a paid license. Evaluation, personal, and lab use is free. See the BentleyPC Commercial License for full terms. Buy License License & Terms

panel.title: CPU pressure some avg10 (% - per host)

search.query: | mstats avg("psi.psi_cpu_some_avg10") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1

panel.title: IO pressure some avg10 (% - per host)

search.query: | mstats avg("psi.psi_io_some_avg10") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1

panel.title: Memory pressure full avg10 (% - per host)

search.query: | mstats avg("psi.psi_mem_full_avg10") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
| mstats avg("psi.psi_io_total_ms") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
